binds.addAllDescription: This replaces your entire bind config with the full recommended set. Any custom binds are removed.
binds.clearDescription: This removes every bind from your config. Saved binds in local storage are cleared too.
binds.commandQuoteError: Double quotes (") are not allowed: CS2 cfg files cannot escape them inside a bind. Use say gg instead of say "gg".
binds.empty: No binds yet. Click a key and assign a command.

rec-build-info-toggle.description: Hide or show the version/build watermark in the bottom-left corner. Default is on; Valve asks for it in bug clips, so keep a key to bring it back.
rec-build-info-toggle.label: Toggle build info text

rec-buy-awp.description: AWP with armor and a couple of nades.
rec-buy-awp.label: AWP buy

rec-buy-force.description: Light armor, cheap rifle and two nades for eco breaks.
rec-buy-force.label: Force buy

rec-buy-full.description: Rifle, armor, full utility and defuser. Wrong-team weapons are ignored, so it works on T and CT. `buy m4a1` is the M4A4.
rec-buy-full.label: Full buy

rec-buy-pistol.description: Deagle, full armor and a flash for anti-eco rounds.
rec-buy-pistol.label: Pistol + armor

rec-drop.description: Drops whatever you are holding. Select the bomb first to drop C4.
rec-drop.label: Drop item

rec-flash.description: Instant flash. CS2 slot 7 — sits under WASD on Z/X/C row.
rec-flash.label: Flashbang

rec-fps-toggle.description: Show or hide the FPS overlay on demand.
rec-fps-toggle.label: Toggle FPS counter

rec-hand-toggle.description: CS2 hand swap. H is the default bind. Persistent preference is `cl_prefer_lefthanded` in config — `cl_righthand` is gone.
rec-hand-toggle.label: Swap weapon hand

rec-inspect.description: Hold to inspect the equipped weapon or knife.
rec-inspect.label: Inspect weapon

rec-knife.description: Fast knife for movement and bhops without scrolling.
rec-knife.label: Quick knife

rec-lineup-release.description: Press with Space at jump peak for consistent smoke lineups. Single-action bind — safe on Valve MM.
rec-lineup-release.label: Lineup release

rec-molotov.description: Fire grenade on one key. Slot 10 (T molotov / CT incendiary).
rec-molotov.label: Molotov / Incendiary

rec-mwheel-jump.description: Bind jump to scroll for more consistent bunny hops. Single action — Valve MM safe.
rec-mwheel-jump.label: Mouse-wheel jump

rec-ptt.description: Hold to talk on team voice without toggling open mic.
rec-ptt.label: Push-to-talk

rec-radar-hud.description: Step minimap HUD scale during a match.
rec-radar-hud.label: Radar HUD size

rec-radar-zoom.description: Cycle radar zoom (0.25–1.0) to see more or less of the map.
rec-radar-zoom.label: Radar zoom

rec-smoke.description: Instant smoke without the scroll wheel. CS2 slot 8 — most-used execute bind.
rec-smoke.label: Smoke

binds.recommendedSubtitle: MM-safe starter set. Add one at a time or replace your whole bind config.
binds.selectKey: Select a key on the keyboard first.

binds.keyboardHint: Mouse keys, ANSI layout, nav cluster and numpad. Highlighted keys have a bind assigned.
binds.subtitleFull: Build your config from scratch or pull binds from the recommended catalog, then export bind lines or a cfg snippet.

binds.selectKeyHint: Select a key on the keyboard to add or edit a bind.
binds.emptyList: No binds yet. <link>Pick from recommended binds</link> or click a key on the keyboard.
binds.recommendedLeadFull: Pick only the binds you want. Each one is Valve MM safe and uses 2026 meta keys — add individually or take the full set.

config.addAllDescription: This applies the full recommended cvar set and replaces conflicting values. You can still tweak anything afterward.
config.addAllRecommendedDescription: This replaces your entire config with the full recommended set. Custom values and manual edits are removed.
config.alwaysCenteredDescription: cl_radar_always_centered — off shows more of the map.
config.alwaysLoadoutDescription: cl_showloadout — always show the weapon loadout panel.
config.bufferTicksDescription: cl_net_buffer_ticks — extra snapshot delay. This is what actually drives interp in CS2. Do not set cl_interp or cl_cmdrate.
config.buildInfoDescription: r_show_build_info — version/debug overlay in the corner.

rec-audio-clean.description: Silences round/menu/MVP music, keeps the bomb timer beep, and tames teammate voice volume. Voice uses `snd_voipvolume` — `voice_scale` is gone.
rec-audio-clean.label: Mute music, lower voice

rec-hud-classic-sniper-scope.description: Hides the Oct 2025 inaccuracy circle on AWP and SSG 08 — restores the old static overlay. Settings → Game → Sniper Sights → Show Scoped Sniper Rifle Inaccuracy → No.
rec-hud-classic-sniper-scope.label: Classic AWP/Scout scope

rec-hud-hide-build-info.description: Removes the version/debug overlay in the corner — cleaner competitive HUD.
rec-hud-hide-build-info.label: Hide build info text

rec-hud-readable.description: Green accent, slightly smaller HUD, and teammate colors with letters.
rec-hud-readable.label: Readable competitive HUD

rec-hud-teamid-fade.description: Max fade (1.0) when your crosshair is on a teammate — less name clutter in fights. 0 disables fade.
rec-hud-teamid-fade.label: Fade teammate names at crosshair

rec-mouse-raw.description: Keep scoped sensitivity 1:1 with hip-fire. Raw input is always on in CS2 — `m_rawinput` is gone.
rec-mouse-raw.label: 1.0 zoom sensitivity ratio

rec-network-competitive.description: Unrestricted rate and zero extra buffer ticks — Valve’s low-latency default. `cl_cmdrate` / `cl_updaterate` / `cl_interp` do not exist as player settings in CS2.
rec-network-competitive.label: Competitive network

rec-perf-fps.description: Uncapped in-game FPS with 120 fps menu cap.
rec-perf-fps.label: Uncapped FPS + UI cap

rec-perf-low-latency.description: Moves the Reflex/low-latency sleep after client sim. Pair with a real `fps_max`, not 0.
rec-perf-low-latency.label: Engine low-latency sleep

rec-perf-no-clutter.description: Turns off auto-help and the game instructor.
rec-perf-no-clutter.label: Disable help popups

rec-perf-no-tracers.description: Less visual noise when spraying — common FPS tweak.
rec-perf-no-tracers.label: Hide first-person tracers

rec-radar-lineups.description: Zoomed-out minimap with larger HUD element — common execute setup.
rec-radar-lineups.label: Competitive radar (lineups)

rec-vm-valve.description: Stock viewmodel FOV and offsets — baseline before tweaking.
rec-vm-valve.label: Valve default viewmodel

rec-vm-wide.description: FOV 68, offsets 2.5 / 2 / -2. presetpos 0 so the offsets stick — 1/2/3 override them.
rec-vm-wide.label: Wide competitive viewmodel

config.leftHandedDescription: cl_prefer_lefthanded — CS2 replacement for removed cl_righthand. switchhands still toggles mid-round.
config.lowLatencyDescription: engine_low_latency_sleep_after_client_tick — pair with a real fps_max, not 0.
config.muteAltTabDescription: snd_mute_losefocus — mute the game when alt-tabbed.

wide-competitive.description: FOV 68, offsets 2.5 / 2 / -2. presetpos 0 so the offsets stick.
wide-competitive.label: Wide competitive

config.rateDescription: rate — max bytes/sec from the server. 786432 is Unrestricted in the menu.
config.recommendedSubtitle: Curated cvar bundles. Add one at a time or apply the full set.
config.resetDescription: This restores default cvars. Recommended patches and manual edits are cleared.
config.rotateRadarDescription: cl_radar_rotate — rotate the radar with your view.
config.sniperInaccuracyDescription: cl_sniper_show_inaccuracy — moving spread circle on AWP/SSG 08. Off restores the classic overlay.

sections.exportDescription: Share code for in-game settings, plus console commands for autoexec or the console.

0.description: Cross that spreads with real weapon inaccuracy.
0.label: Dynamic Cross

1.description: Ring that grows with real weapon inaccuracy.
1.label: Dynamic Circle

2.description: CS:GO-era dynamic cross with split arms and negative gaps.
2.label: Dynamic Cross (Classic)

4.description: Fixed cross. Most common in pro configs.
4.label: Static Cross

5.description: Static cross that only reacts when firing.
5.label: Dynamic Cross (Legacy/Shot Feedback)

6.description: Just the center dot. Sized by thickness.
6.label: Dot Only

7.description: Four arcs that spread with inaccuracy. Game default.
7.label: Dynamic Quadrant

9.description: Fixed ring split into four arcs. Arc size is adjustable.
9.label: Static Quadrant

crosshair.subtitle: Import a CS2 share code, tweak pixel-exact settings, then copy the share code, console commands, or both back into the game.
crosshair.title: Crosshair editor
crosshair.exportHint: Paste the code into CS2 Settings → Crosshair. The block below is the same crosshair as cvars.
crosshair.importDialogDescription: Paste a CS… code from CS2 settings. Older CSGO-… codes are converted automatically.
crosshair.importToastConvertedDesc: Old codes used resolution-relative units. Sizes were converted for 1080p and may be off by a pixel.
crosshair.importToastLegacyDesc: This code predates outline colors and scope-dot settings; defaults were used for those.
crosshair.screenHeightHint: Sizes are in pixels. CS2 keeps the crosshair the same relative size when you play at a different resolution.
